map.r=深蹲×卧推÷硬拉1RM。健康力量结构下硬拉最大，比值较低；若比值明显偏高，提: r = squat x bench / deadlift 1RM. In a healthy strength structure the deadlift is largest, so the ratio is low; if the ratio is clearly high, it signals the deadlift is relatively weak vs squat/bench and is a training weakness. It does not replace 1RM itself, only for comparing the three big lifts' structure.
